一种BIM编辑指令分类方法，将指令分为直接指令、空间指令和拓扑指令三类，用于系统化探测LLM在结构化设计环境中的能力。
一种将基于IFC的BIM模型转换为LLM可处理表示形式的方法，在转换过程中保留几何、语义和关系结构以支持编辑任务。

title: Modularity-Free Conflict-Averse Training for Generalized PINNs
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have become a powerful framework for solving PDEs by embedding physical laws into differentiable objectives. Despite their advances, training PINNs remains fragile: recent conflict-averse optimization schemes alleviate gradient interference between residual and boundary losses, but we show that their effectiveness deteriorates as model capacity increases. In this paper, we identify a capacity-induced failure mode, where overparameterized networks undergo functional modularity, self-partitioning into task-exclusive modules that suppress cross-objective interaction and hinder convergence toward Pareto-stationary points. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework, Modular-Sparsity Synchronization (ModSync), which integrates structural optimization into conflict-averse training by penalizing task-exclusive connections while preserving interaction-promoting pathways. Extensive experiments across diverse PDE benchmarks demonstrate that ModSync consistently prevents capacity-driven failures, sustains robust cross-objective coupling, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. Codes are available at \url{https://github.com/heejokong/ModSync}.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现过参数化PINNs中出现了功能模块化现象（网络自划分为任务专属模块），导致多目标冲突优化失效，并提出Modular-Sparsity Synchronization (ModSync)框架，通过惩罚任务专属连接、保留促进交互的通路来解决该问题，实现了最先进精度。
AI.motivation: 尽管冲突规避优化方法能缓解梯度干扰，但随着模型容量增加其效果显著下降。作者发现过参数化网络会自组织成任务专属模块，抑制跨目标交互，阻碍收敛到帕累托驻点。
AI.method: 提出Modular-Sparsity Synchronization (ModSync)框架，将结构优化集成到冲突规避训练中，通过惩罚任务专属连接（鼓励稀疏性）同时保留促进跨目标交互的通路，实现模块-稀疏性同步。
AI.result: 在多种PDE基准测试中，ModSync持续防止容量驱动失败，维持鲁棒的跨目标耦合，并达到最先进精度。
AI.conclusion: 识别了PINNs中由容量驱动的功能模块化失败模式，并提出了有效的ModSync解决方案。
idea_en: Modular-Sparsity Synchronization (ModSync) framework that integrates structural optimization into conflict-averse training for PINNs by penalizing task-exclusive neural connections while preserving interaction-promoting pathways.
A method to detect and mitigate capacity-induced functional modularity in overparameterized PINNs, where networks self-partition into task-exclusive modules suppressing cross-objective interaction.
A sparsity-synchronization technique that simultaneously encourages modular specialization and cross-task interaction in multi-objective PDE-solving neural networks.
A training paradigm combining conflict-averse optimization with structural regularization to prevent performance deterioration as model capacity increases in PINNs.
idea_ch: Modular-Sparsity Synchronization (ModSync)框架：将结构优化集成到PINN冲突规避训练中，通过惩罚任务专属连接同时保留促进交互通路的方法。
一种检测并缓解过参数化PINN中容量驱动功能模块化现象的方法，该现象表现为网络自划分为抑制跨目标交互的任务专属模块。
面向多目标PDE求解神经网络的稀疏同步技术：同时鼓励模块专业化和跨任务交互。
结合冲突规避优化与结构正则化的训练范式，防止PINN中随模型容量增加而性能退化的问题。

title: Implicit Semantic-Aware Communication Based on Hypergraph Reasoning
comment: This work is accepted at IEEE Transactions on Communications
summary: Semantic-aware communication has emerged as a transformative paradigm for next-generation communication systems, shifting the fundamental goal from transmitting bit-level symbols to reliably recovering and understanding the semantic meaning of information. Previous studies have demonstrated that representing the semantic content of source messages as graph-based structures can significantly improve communication efficiency and the accuracy of semantic inference at the receiver. However, existing solutions typically employ graphs that capture only pairwise relationships, thereby neglecting higher-order implicit correlations commonly observed in real-world scenarios, such as group interactions, multi-entity associations, and complex relational contexts. This limitation reduces semantic expressiveness and makes semantic inference susceptible to ambiguity and performance degradation, particularly under noisy or corrupted channel conditions. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel hypergraph-based implicit semantic reasoning framework, HISR, which leverages hypergraphs to represent complex multi-entity relationships among semantic knowledge entities. In HISR, entities and their associated higher-order relations are mapped into dedicated semantic subspaces tailored to distinct relational contexts. This design not only disentangles diverse semantic interactions to mitigate the over-smoothing effects commonly found in traditional graph embedding methods but also enables robust semantic inference even when partial information loss occurs during transmission. Numerical results show that the proposed HISR achieves up to a 36.6% improvement in implicit semantic interpretation accuracy over the state-of-the-art benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HISR框架，利用超图（hypergraph）代替传统图结构来捕捉语义知识实体间的高阶隐式关联（如群体交互、多实体关联），通过将实体及其高阶关系映射到专用语义子空间，实现了更鲁棒的语义推理，在噪声信道下准确率提升达36.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有语义通信方案使用仅捕捉成对关系的图结构，忽略了现实场景中常见的高阶隐式关联（如群体交互、多实体关联），导致语义表达力不足，在噪声或信道损坏条件下易产生歧义和性能下降。
AI.method: 提出超图隐式语义推理框架HISR：1）用超图表示语义知识实体间的多实体高阶关系；2）将实体及其高阶关系映射到专用于不同关系上下文的语义子空间；3）通过解耦不同语义交互来缓解传统图嵌入中的过平滑问题。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，HISR在隐式语义解释准确率上比最先进基准方法提升高达36.6%。
AI.conclusion: 超图表示的高阶语义关联能有效提升语义通信的鲁棒性和准确性，尤其在部分信息丢失的条件下仍能实现可靠的语义推理。
idea_en: A hypergraph-based semantic representation method for communication systems that captures higher-order implicit correlations (e.g., group interactions, multi-entity associations) among semantic knowledge entities, replacing traditional pairwise graph structures.

A dedicated semantic subspace mapping technique that maps entities and their associated higher-order relations into distinct relational context subspaces, enabling disentanglement of diverse semantic interactions.

A robust semantic inference mechanism that leverages hypergraph representations to maintain accurate semantic understanding under partial information loss or noisy channel conditions during transmission.
An anti-over-smoothing method for semantic graph embedding that uses hypergraph-based subspace disentanglement to mitigate the over-smoothing effects common in traditional graph embedding approaches.
idea_ch: 一种基于超图（Hypergraph）的语义表示方法，用于通信系统中捕获语义知识实体间的高阶隐式关联（如群体交互、多实体关联），替代传统的成对关系图结构。
一种专用语义子空间映射技术，将实体及其高阶关系映射到不同关系上下文对应的语义子空间中，实现多种语义交互的解耦。
一种鲁棒语义推理机制，利用超图表示在传输过程中部分信息丢失或噪声信道条件下，仍能保持准确的语义理解。
一种用于语义图嵌入的抗过平滑方法，通过基于超图的子空间解耦技术缓解传统图嵌入方法中常见的过平滑问题。

title: Apparent Psychological Profiles of Large Language Models are Largely a Measurement Artifact
summary: Psychological instruments designed for humans are increasingly used to assign large language models (LLMs) stable psychological profiles that affect their usability, safety assessment, and use as proxies for human participants in research. Using a formal psychometric framework, we show that these profiles are largely a measurement artifact. Administering a battery of personality and risk-preference instruments spanning self-reports and behavioral tasks to 56 instruction-tuned LLMs alongside large human reference samples, we report four findings. First, differences between models are driven not by the traits an instrument targets but by a directional response bias, a tendency to respond toward one end of the scale, or one labeled option, regardless of item content; a variance decomposition attributes 81-90% of between-model variation to this bias, against 9-16% in humans. Second, the bias declines with model capability but is not eliminated by it. Third, because bias rather than trait drives responding, an instrument's apparent reliability is almost entirely predicted by its response orthogonality, a term we coin for the proportion of items for which trait and bias point in opposite directions. Fourth, the profile a model appears to have shifts with the items used and can be manufactured through item selection. These results demonstrate that the apparent psychological profiles of LLMs are artifacts of the instrument used to measure them, not properties of the models themselves. As instruments borrowed from human psychology are rarely fully orthogonal and may inherently lack validity for LLMs, we call for dedicated assessments centered on response orthogonality.

AI.tldr: 本文通过形式化心理测量框架，证明给大语言模型（LLMs）分配的心理档案主要是测量伪影，而非模型本身的属性。研究发现模型间差异的81-90%来自方向性反应偏差，而非目标特质，且该偏差随模型能力下降但无法消除，模型的心理特征可通过题目选择人为制造。
AI.motivation: 揭示当前使用人类心理量表为大语言模型赋予心理档案的做法存在根本性方法论缺陷，这些档案反映的是测量工具的伪影而非模型真实特质，从而警示相关研究者和从业者重新审视评估方法。
AI.method: 对56个指令微调LLM施测涵盖自我报告和行为任务的人格与风险偏好量表，同时收集大规模人类参考样本；采用方差分解、响应正交性分析等方法进行系统比较。
AI.result: 模型间差异的81-90%由方向性反应偏差解释（人类仅9-16%）；偏差随模型能力提升而下降但无法消除；量表的信度几乎完全由其"响应正交性"预测；模型的心理档案可通过题目选择被操纵。
AI.conclusion: LLM表现出的心理档案是测量工具的伪影，源自方向性反应偏差和响应正交性不足，呼吁开发以响应正交性为中心的专用评估方法。
idea_en: A method for constructing orthogonal psychological assessment instruments specifically for LLMs, where each item is designed such that the target trait and directional response bias point in opposite directions, enabling genuine trait measurement free from bias artifacts.

A bias calibration and subtraction technique for LLM psychological profiling that pre-computes each model's directional response bias using a set of neutral/orthogonal items, then subtracts this bias from raw scores to recover trait-level estimates.

An adaptive item selection algorithm for LLM assessment that dynamically selects test items to maximize response orthogonality, thereby producing bias-free personality profiles regardless of the model's inherent response tendencies.

A benchmarking framework that measures LLM response bias independently of psychological traits, using paired items with opposite trait directions but identical surface features, enabling disentanglement of bias from genuine trait variation.

A method for generating synthetic control items with known orthogonality properties to serve as calibration anchors, allowing researchers to quantify and correct for response bias in any psychological instrument administered to LLMs.
idea_ch: 一种专为LLMs设计正交心理评估工具的方法，每个题目使目标特质与方向性反应偏差指向相反方向，确保测量真实特质而避免偏差伪影。
一种用于LLM心理档案分析的偏差校准与扣除技术，通过一组中性/正交题目预先计算每个模型的方向性反应偏差，然后从原始分数中扣除该偏差以恢复特质水平估计。
一种面向LLM评估的自适应题目选择算法，动态选择最大响应正交性的题目，无论模型的固有反应倾向如何，都能生成无偏差的人格档案。
一种独立于心理特质测量LLM反应偏差的基准测试框架，使用表面特征相同但特质方向相反的成对题目，使偏差与真实特质变异分离。
一种生成已知正交性属性的合成控制题目的方法，作为校准锚点，使研究者能够量化和校正任何LLM心理测量中的反应偏差。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Measuring Logical Compliance of Predictive Models
summary: Machine learning models are predominantly evaluated through predictive performance metrics such as ranking quality, prediction error, or classification accuracy. While these metrics effectively quantify how closely predictions match the ground truth, they do not assess whether model outputs respect predefined logical or domain-specific constraints. In high-stakes applications, including healthcare, finance, and autonomous systems, logical consistency can be as critical as predictive accuracy, yet no standard metric captures this dimension. We introduce the Rule Violation Score (RVS), a complementary evaluation metric that quantifies the extent to which a predictive model respects a given set of logical rules, independently of predictive accuracy. RVS treats hard rules (strict constraints) and soft rules (statistical regularities) differently, can be evaluated on any dataset and on any predictive model expressed over a relational vocabulary, and can be computed using SQL queries that are automatically generated for Horn rules. Beyond evaluating models, RVS can also evaluate the logical consistency of training datasets and help identify poorly defined rules. We evaluate RVS on three benchmarks covering knowledge graph link prediction and relational regression, including rule-based, embedding-based, and neuro-symbolic predictive models. Our results demonstrate that two models achieving comparable predictive accuracy can exhibit substantially different levels of logical compliance, revealing differences in model behavior that standard metrics fail to capture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出规则违反分数(RVS)，用于评估预测模型对逻辑规则的遵守程度，补充传统性能指标，揭示逻辑一致性差异。
AI.motivation: 传统评估指标仅关注预测精度，无法衡量模型输出是否遵守逻辑或领域特定约束。在高风险应用中，逻辑一致性与预测准确性同等重要，但缺乏标准度量方法。
AI.method: RVS将规则分为硬规则（严格约束）和软规则（统计规律），可针对任意数据集和基于关系词汇表达的预测模型进行评估，并通过自动生成的SQL查询对Horn规则进行计算。
AI.result: 在知识图谱链接预测和关系回归三个基准上的实验表明，两个预测精度相当的模型可能表现出显著不同的逻辑合规性水平，揭示了标准指标无法捕捉的行为差异。
AI.conclusion: RVS是一个互补评估指标，不仅能评估模型，还能评估训练数据集的逻辑一致性并帮助识别定义不当的规则。
idea_en: Rule Violation Score (RVS) as a complementary metric for evaluating logical consistency of predictive models independently from predictive accuracy
Hard rules and soft rules differentiated treatment in a single evaluation metric for logical constraint compliance
Automatic SQL query generation from Horn rules to compute rule violation scores on any relational dataset
Dual-use RVS methodology for evaluating both model outputs and training dataset logical consistency
Rule-based identification of poorly defined logical rules through violation pattern analysis
idea_ch: 规则违反分数(RVS)：独立于预测精度的逻辑一致性评估指标，用于量化模型对逻辑规则的遵守程度
硬规则与软规则区分处理机制：在同一评估框架下分别处理严格约束和统计规律两类规则
基于Horn规则的自动SQL查询生成技术：将逻辑规则自动转化为SQL查询以实现规则违反分数的计算
双用途RVS方法：既可评估预测模型的逻辑一致性，也可评估训练数据集的逻辑一致性
规则缺陷自动识别：通过违反模式分析帮助发现定义不当或冲突的逻辑规则

title: Augmenting Game AI with Deep Reinforcement Learning
comment: Vision paper, published in Conference on Games 2026
summary: Immersion in video games depends not only on graphics, audio, and game mechanics, but also on the quality of in-game characters. Producing believable characters, or game AI, remains a significant challenge as behavioral complexity is hard to capture with hand-coded systems. Game AI is a source of immersion and engagement; however, the limitations stemming from the challenges of creating game AI often lead to frustration and the breaking of the illusion of realism within the game. The introduction of machine learning models opens the door to creating more believable, authentic, and relatable characters in games. The promise is that they either learn from interacting with the game, or from player data, to develop true human-like behavior. In this paper, we envision more applications of reinforcement learning for game AI in the future. For this to materialize, current research limitations are prohibitive to broad deployment across game genres. Therefore, we propose a framework for training reinforcement learning models with a set of requirements in mind that are suited towards game AI and game development. We present examples of games with reinforcement learning-augmented game AI and describe the practicalities of deploying player-facing machine learning agents in modern games. Furthermore, we identify bottlenecks and hard problems in these areas, which we believe offer promising research directions to accelerate the adoption of machine learning in game AI for the video game industry.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了强化学习在游戏AI中的应用，提出了一个面向游戏AI和游戏开发需求的强化学习训练框架，并分析了当前部署玩家-facing机器学习智能体的瓶颈与挑战。
AI.motivation: 游戏中手工编写的AI难以捕捉行为复杂性，导致角色不真实、破坏沉浸感。引入机器学习（尤其是强化学习）有望创造更可信、更人性化的游戏角色。
AI.method: 提出了一套针对游戏AI的强化学习训练框架，包含特定的需求设计（如实时性、可控性、可解释性等），并通过实际游戏案例展示了强化学习增强的游戏AI部署方法。
AI.result: 识别了当前强化学习在游戏AI中广泛部署的瓶颈，包括训练效率、泛化能力、玩家体验适配等问题，并指出了有前景的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习有潜力大幅提升游戏AI的真实感和沉浸感，但需解决现有局限性，所提出的框架和方向可加速ML在游戏行业中的应用。
idea_en: A framework for training reinforcement learning models tailored specifically for game AI, with requirements including real-time performance, controllability, and explainability.
A method for deploying player-facing machine learning agents in modern games, enabling human-like behavior learned from player data or game interaction.
Bottleneck identification and solution directions for integrating reinforcement learning across diverse game genres.
idea_ch: 一种面向游戏AI的强化学习训练框架，包含实时性、可控性和可解释性等专有需求设计
一种在现代游戏中部署面向玩家的机器学习智能体的方法，通过玩家数据或游戏交互学习类人行为
识别跨游戏类型的强化学习集成瓶颈及其解决方向，加速ML在游戏行业的落地

title: QMFOL: Benchmarking Large Language Model Reasoning via Quantifiable Monadic First-Order Logic Test Case Generation
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have made significant progress in reasoning, particularly in deductive reasoning, which is crucial for high-stakes decision-making. As models improve, evaluation benchmarks should evolve to keep pace. However, existing benchmarks lack fine-grained control over logical complexity and struggle to balance semantic diversity with logical consistency.
  To address these issues, we propose QMFOL, an automated framework for generating monadic first-order logic reasoning tasks with quantifiable and controllable complexity. It constructs formal logical structures using conjunction and disjunction patterns, enabling precise control over reasoning depth, width, label types, and distractors. These structures are then translated into natural language via LLMs, with logical consistency ensured through round-trip verification using an external prover. Based on our framework, we build QMFOLBench, a benchmark comprising 2880 instances with 960 configurations across diverse logical and semantic dimensions. Evaluations on six large reasoning models (LRMs) and two LLMs show that performance degrades and computational overhead increases with rising logical complexity. Models perform better on True-labeled tasks than on False or Unknown ones, and exhibit sensitivity to semantic variation. Overall, QMFOL offers a scalable and reliable approach for constructing deductive reasoning benchmarks with controllable complexity, enabling more precise evaluation of reasoning capabilities in modern language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QMFOL框架，可自动生成具有可量化和可控复杂度的单调一阶逻辑推理任务，构建了包含2880个实例的基准测试QMFOLBench，用于评估大语言模型的演绎推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有推理基准测试缺乏对逻辑复杂度的细粒度控制，且在语义多样性与逻辑一致性之间难以平衡。
AI.method: 利用合取和析取模式构建形式逻辑结构，精确控制推理深度、宽度、标签类型和干扰项，然后通过LLM翻译为自然语言，并利用外部证明器进行往返验证确保逻辑一致性。
AI.result: 在6个大型推理模型和2个LLM上的评估显示：性能随逻辑复杂度增加而下降、计算开销增加；模型在True标签任务上优于False和Unknown任务；对语义变化敏感。
AI.conclusion: QMFOL提供了一种可扩展、可靠的演绎推理基准构建方法，支持可控复杂度，能够更精确评估现代语言模型的推理能力。
idea_en: A method for automatically generating deductive reasoning benchmarks with quantifiable and controllable logical complexity using conjunction/disjunction patterns to precisely control reasoning depth, width, label types, and distractors.
A round-trip verification mechanism using an external theorem prover to ensure logical consistency when translating formal logical structures into natural language via LLMs.
A framework (QMFOL) that enables fine-grained control over multiple dimensions of logical complexity simultaneously, allowing systematic evaluation of model reasoning degradation patterns.
A benchmark construction approach that systematically varies semantic content while maintaining identical logical structure, enabling measurement of semantic sensitivity in reasoning models.
A system for generating monadic first-order logic reasoning tasks with configurable distractor complexity to test model robustness against irrelevant information.
idea_ch: 一种利用合取/析取模式自动生成具有可量化和可控逻辑复杂度的演绎推理基准的方法，能精确控制推理深度、宽度、标签类型和干扰项。
一种利用外部定理证明器进行往返验证的机制，确保将形式逻辑结构通过LLM翻译为自然语言时的逻辑一致性。
一种同时多维度精细控制逻辑复杂度的框架(QMFOL)，可系统评估模型推理能力随复杂度退化的模式。
一种在保持相同逻辑结构前提下系统变化语义内容的基准构建方法，用于测量推理模型对语义变化的敏感度。
一种生成具有可配置干扰项复杂度的单调一阶逻辑推理任务的系统，用于测试模型对抗无关信息的鲁棒性。

title: Thermodynamic Measure of Intelligence
summary: Can intelligence be measured? We propose that intelligence can be defined as the lawful amplification of rare but valid futures: a system increases the probability of outcomes that would be unlikely under passive dynamics but remain admissible under the constraints of the domain. We start with the premise that an intelligent system must model the world and its own place within it. Because the system is part of the world it models, this leads naturally to recursive self-simulation: the system represents futures in which its own actions are part of the trajectory. Our central results give a necessity statement and a conditional near-sufficiency statement connecting this architecture to a precise thermodynamic measure of lawful amplification of rare-valid futures: high rare-valid lift is impossible unless the internal simulation identifies rare-valid futures with high fidelity; conversely, when rare-valid fidelity is high and the simulation contains an effective policy, the achievable lift approaches the actuation-limited optimum. Thus recursive self-simulation is not merely a plausible feature of intelligence but, under the stated assumptions, is necessary and nearly sufficient for high thermodynamic intelligence. The resulting framework makes intelligence measurable on a universal scale, from passive matter and feedback controllers, large language models, and humans as text generators to Maxwell-demon-like information engines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出智能可定义为"对稀有但有效未来的合法放大"，并证明递归自模拟架构（系统在自身世界模型中模拟自身）是实现高"热力学智能"的必要且近乎充分的条件，从而给出智能的通用可测量框架。
AI.motivation: 现有智能定义模糊且难以量化测量，作者希望建立一种基于热力学原理的、可跨不同系统（从无生命物质到AI到人类）通用的智能测量方法。
AI.method: 从"智能系统必须建模世界及自身在世界中的位置"这一前提出发，推导出递归自模拟架构的必然性。通过热力学框架定义"稀有-有效提升"（rare-valid lift）作为智能的度量，证明递归自模拟与高提升之间的必要性和近似充分性关系。
AI.result: 得出必要性定理：高稀有-有效提升必须依赖内部模拟以高保真度识别稀有-有效未来；以及条件近似充分性定理：当保真度高且模拟包含有效策略时，可实现接近驱动受限最优的提升。
AI.conclusion: 递归自模拟不是智能的偶然特征，而是高热力学智能的必要条件；该框架使智能在通用尺度上可测量，适用于被动物质、反馈控制器、大语言模型、人类文本生成者乃至麦克斯韦妖式信息引擎。
idea_en: A method for measuring intelligence of a system based on thermodynamic 'rare-valid lift' metric, where intelligence is quantified by the system's ability to lawfully amplify outcomes that are rare under passive dynamics but valid under domain constraints.

An architecture for intelligent systems that implements recursive self-simulation, where the system models the world and itself as part of that model, enabling identification and amplification of rare-valid futures.

A necessity-sufficiency framework linking recursive self-simulation to thermodynamic efficiency, establishing that high thermodynamic intelligence cannot exist without internal simulation that identifies rare-valid futures with high fidelity.

A universal intelligence measurement scale applicable across heterogeneous systems including passive matter, feedback controllers, large language models, human text generators, and Maxwell-demon-like information engines, using the same thermodynamic baseline.
idea_ch: 一种基于热力学'稀有-有效提升'指标的智能测量方法，通过系统在被动动力学下稀有但领域约束下有效的成果的合法放大能力来量化智能。
一种实现递归自模拟的智能系统架构，系统对世界及其自身在世界模型中的位置进行建模，从而实现对稀有-有效未来的识别与放大。
一种必要性-充分性框架，将递归自模拟结构与热力学效率相关联，证明缺乏高保真度识别稀有-有效未来的内部模拟则不可能存在高热力学智能。
一种跨异质系统的通用智能测量标度，适用于被动物质、反馈控制器、大语言模型、人类文本生成者及麦克斯韦妖式信息引擎，使用统一的热力学基线。

title: A Multi-Agent system for Multi-Objective constrained optimization
comment: Presented at the 17th Workshop on Optimization and Learning in Multiagent Systems (OptLearnMAS, https://optlearnmas.github.io), co-located with the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026)
summary: Many decision-making problems in computing and networking systems can be naturally formulated as cost-minimization problems under performance constraints. In dynamic environments, reinforcement learning (RL) is often used to solve such problems at runtime by embedding both costs and constraint violations into a single scalar reward through weighted penalty terms, following a Lagrangian-inspired formulation. However, in this context the behavior of the learned policy critically depends on the choice of these weights, which are typically selected manually. This makes it difficult to identify an appropriate trade-off between optimizing the primary objective and effectively avoiding constraint violations, particularly in non-stationary environments where their relative importance may change. This paper presents MAMO (Multi-Agent system for Multi-Objective constrained optimization), an approach to tackle this balancing problem through multi-agent RL. MAMO decouples task execution from objective design by formulating the selection of reward weights as a learning problem, providing a !rst step towards more autonomous and robust RL-based solutions for constrained optimization problems in dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: MAMO是一种基于多智能体强化学习的方法，将约束优化问题中的奖励权重选择建模为学习问题，实现任务执行与目标设计的解耦，从而在动态环境中自动平衡主要目标优化与约束避免。
AI.motivation: 在动态环境中，基于强化学习的约束优化问题通常依赖手动选择奖励权重来平衡主要目标和约束违反，但手动调参难以适应非平稳环境，且无法自动找到合适的权衡点。
AI.method: MAMO采用多智能体强化学习，将奖励权重的选择也建模为一个学习问题，从而将任务执行与目标设计解耦，使系统能自主学习和调整权重以适配动态环境。
AI.result: MAMO为更自主、鲁棒的基于RL的约束优化方案提供了第一步，能够在动态环境中自动平衡主要目标与约束违规惩罚。
AI.conclusion: MAMO通过多智能体RL将权重选择学习化，提高了RL在动态约束优化问题中的自主性和鲁棒性，但论文表明这只是初步探索。
idea_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for automatically learning and adjusting reward weights in constrained optimization problems
Decoupled architecture separating task execution from objective design through learned weight selection
Autonomous reward weight adaptation mechanism for non-stationary dynamic environments
System for balancing cost minimization and constraint violation avoidance via learned multi-objective trade-offs
idea_ch: 基于多智能体强化学习的奖励权重自动学习与调整方法，用于约束优化问题

通过学习的多目标权衡策略，自动平衡成本最小化与约束违反避免的系统

title: Navigating Unreliable Parametric and Contextual Knowledge: Explicit Knowledge Conflict Resolution for LLM Inference
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across a wide range of language-based tasks by leveraging both extensive parametric knowledge and in-context learning ability, enabling them to incorporate external information provided in the input prompt. However, the integration of external knowledge can introduce conflicts, not only between the model's internal parametric knowledge and the external information, but also among multiple pieces of external contexts. Existing approaches typically assume that either the model or the provided context is reliable, overlooking the possibility that both sources may contain errors, and avoid conflicts by privileging one source over the other, rather than actively resolving inconsistencies. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework MACR for LLM knowledge conflict resolution that moves beyond the conventional binary choice paradigm and incorporates an explicit conflict-resolution mechanism based on a multi-agent reasoning approach. Specifically, we first propose an adaptive knowledge assessment and retrieval approach that employs a modified semantic entropy measure to quantify an LLM's confidence in its answer to a given query. Based on this confidence estimation, MACR either externalizes the model's internal knowledge as textual representations or retrieves relevant external knowledge when internal knowledge is insufficient, generating basic contexts for subsequent reasoning. Then we introduce an inductive multi-agent reasoning framework with three specialized agents that, respectively, induce explicit rules, analyze potential conflicts, and resolve inconsistencies across all available contexts. Empirical results demonstrate that MACR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across benchmarks, while also providing interpretable resolutions of explicit conflicts.

AI.tldr: 提出MACR框架，通过多智能体推理和自适应知识评估检索机制，主动解决LLM中内部参数知识与外部上下文之间的知识冲突，而非简单偏向某一方。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理知识冲突时，要么假设模型可靠，要么假设外部上下文可靠，采用二选一的特权机制而非主动解决矛盾，忽略了双方都可能存在错误的情况。
AI.method: 1) 自适应知识评估与检索：使用改进的语义熵量化模型置信度，低置信度时外化内部知识为文本，高置信度时检索外部知识；2) 归纳式多智能体推理框架：包含三个专用智能体，分别负责归纳显式规则、分析潜在冲突、解决所有可用上下文中的不一致。
AI.result: 在多个基准上显著优于现有最先进方法，同时提供可解释的显式冲突解决方案。
AI.conclusion: MACR突破了二元选择范式，通过多智能体推理主动解决知识冲突，提升了LLM在存在知识矛盾场景下的表现和可解释性。
idea_en: A multi-agent reasoning framework for LLM knowledge conflict resolution that includes specialized agents for rule induction, conflict analysis, and inconsistency resolution across multiple knowledge sources.
An adaptive knowledge assessment method using modified semantic entropy to quantify LLM confidence, determining whether to externalize internal knowledge or retrieve external knowledge.
A conflict-resolution mechanism that moves beyond binary choice (model vs. context) and actively resolves inconsistencies rather than privileging one source.
A system that converts internal parametric knowledge into textual representations when confidence is low, enabling explicit reasoning over model's own knowledge.
An inductive reasoning approach for conflict resolution that extracts explicit rules from available contexts to guide the resolution process.
idea_ch: 一种用于LLM知识冲突解决的多智能体推理框架，包含规则归纳、冲突分析和不一致性解决三个专用智能体

超越二元选择（模型vs上下文）的冲突解决机制，主动解决不一致性而非偏向某一方

title: Confidence-Aware Automated Assessment of Student-Drawn Scientific Models
summary: Student-generated drawings are widely used in science education to assess learners' conceptual understanding in modeling-based tasks aligned with the Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS). However, scoring such drawings requires expert human judgment to interpret complex visual representations, making large-scale assessment costly to implement and sustain in classroom settings. In this work, we study automated scoring of student-generated scientific drawings using a vision-based model. We evaluate a Vision Transformer (ViT) with parameter-efficient adaptation and propose a confidence-aware scoring framework that derives response-level confidence from test-time predictive distributions. This confidence signal enables selective automation by scoring high-confidence responses automatically while deferring uncertain cases for human review. Experiments on six NGSS-aligned middle school assessment items show that the proposed approach improves scoring reliability while supporting a practical trade-off between automated coverage and scoring risk, highlighting the value of confidence-aware methods for trustworthy educational assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于视觉Transformer（ViT）的学生科学绘图自动评分方法，提出一种置信度感知的评分框架，通过测试时预测分布导出响应级置信度，实现高置信度自动评分、低置信度人工复核的混合评估策略，在六个NGSS初中评估项目上验证了该方法在提升评分可靠性和平衡自动化覆盖率与评分风险方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 学生绘制的科学图画被广泛用于评估概念理解，但人工评分成本高、难以大规模实施，亟需自动化评分方案。
AI.method: 采用参数高效适配的Vision Transformer (ViT) 模型，并设计置信度感知评分框架，从测试时预测分布中提取响应级置信度信号，据此将高置信度响应自动评分、低置信度响应交由人工复审。
AI.result: 在六个NGSS初中评估项目上，所提方法提升了评分可靠性，并实现了自动化覆盖率与评分风险之间的实用权衡。
AI.conclusion: 置信度感知方法对于可信赖的自动化教育评估具有重要价值，能够支持半自动化的评分工作流。
idea_en: A confidence-aware scoring framework for automated assessment of student-generated scientific drawings, which derives response-level confidence signals from test-time predictive distributions of a Vision Transformer model, enabling selective automation by scoring high-confidence responses automatically while deferring uncertain cases for human review.

Parameter-efficient adaptation of Vision Transformer (ViT) for scoring student-generated scientific drawings in NGSS-aligned assessment tasks, reducing computational cost while maintaining scoring accuracy.

A hybrid human-AI assessment workflow for educational drawings that automatically scores high-confidence student responses and flags uncertain cases for human expert review, achieving a practical trade-off between automation coverage and scoring risk.
idea_ch: 一种面向学生科学绘图自动评分的置信度感知评分框架：从视觉Transformer模型的测试时预测分布中提取响应级置信度信号，实现高置信度响应自动评分、不确定案例自动转交人工复核的选择性自动化机制。
参数高效适配的Vision Transformer (ViT) 在NGSS对齐评估任务中对学生科学绘图进行自动评分的方法，在保持评分精度的同时降低计算成本。
人机协同的教育绘图混合评估工作流：自动评分高置信度学生响应，并将不确定案例标记转交人类专家复核，实现自动化覆盖率与评分风险之间的实用权衡。

title: Lagrange: An Open-Vocabulary, Energy-Based Sparse Framework for Generalized End-to-End Driving
summary: Scaling end-to-end autonomous driving to complex, open-world environments requires perceptual models that generalize to anomalous scenarios and planners that produce kinematically valid trajectories. Existing paradigms face a distinct dichotomy between representational efficiency and generalization capacity. Dense models (e.g., occupancy networks), while geometrically robust, incur critical computational bottlenecks and struggle with high-level semantic reasoning. Conversely, sparse, query-based planners are efficient but reliant on closed-set definitions, rendering them vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) events. Although recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer open-vocabulary reasoning, their autoregressive, discrete token generation fundamentally conflicts with the continuous, high-frequency control requirements of vehicle dynamics. To address this, we propose Lagrange, an open-vocabulary, computationally sparse driving framework based on Masked Latent Fields (MLF). Rather than relying on dense volumetric reconstructions or closed-set query mechanisms, Lagrange exploits Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to encode class-agnostic object proposals into continuous semantic visual tokens. We introduce an intent-driven masked cross-attention module that temporally filters irrelevant entities, decoding the attended tokens into an implicit continuous energy field defined over spatial coordinates. By framing decision-making as a Lagrangian action minimization problem spanning this energy field, we enforce strict compliance with vehicle kinematics while executing collision avoidance. Extensive offline evaluations on both standard (nuScenes) and long-tail (CODA) benchmarks demonstrate that Lagrange establishes a promising framework for robust, interpretable, and kinematically feasible open-world autonomy.

AI.tldr: Lagrange提出基于掩码潜在场(MLF)的开放词汇、稀疏计算自动驾驶框架，通过VLM编码类无关目标提案为连续语义视觉令牌，利用意图驱动的掩码交叉注意力模块过滤无关实体，并将决策制定为拉格朗日作用量最小化问题，实现符合车辆运动学的碰撞避免。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶范式在表征效率与泛化能力之间存在矛盾：稠密模型(如占用网络)计算瓶颈大且缺乏高层语义推理能力，稀疏查询规划器效率高但依赖闭集定义、对分布外事件脆弱，VLA模型的自回归离散令牌生成与车辆连续高频控制需求冲突。
AI.method: 1) 利用VLM将类无关目标提案编码为连续语义视觉令牌；2) 引入意图驱动的掩码交叉注意力模块，时序过滤无关实体；3) 将解码后的注意力令牌转化为定义在空间坐标上的隐式连续能量场；4) 将决策制定为拉格朗日作用量最小化问题，在能量场上执行且强制满足车辆运动学约束。
AI.result: 在标准基准(nuScenes)和长尾基准(CODA)上的离线评估表明，Lagrange为鲁棒、可解释且运动学可行的开放世界自动驾驶建立了一个有前景的框架。
AI.conclusion: Lagrange通过掩码潜在场和拉格朗日作用量最小化，有效弥合了开放词汇理解与连续运动控制之间的鸿沟，为开放世界自动驾驶提供了一种兼具稀疏计算效率与强泛化能力的新范式。
idea_en: A masked latent field (MLF) driving framework that encodes class-agnostic object proposals into continuous semantic visual tokens via Vision-Language Models, enabling open-vocabulary perception without relying on closed-set object definitions.

An intent-driven masked cross-attention module that temporally filters irrelevant entities from token sequences, allowing the system to focus on task-relevant objects for autonomous driving decision-making.

A Lagrangian action minimization formulation for trajectory planning that operates over an implicit continuous energy field derived from decoded attention tokens, enforcing strict kinematic compliance and collision avoidance.

A method for converting discrete semantic visual tokens into a continuous energy field defined over spatial coordinates, bridging the gap between discrete token representations and continuous control requirements.

An open-world autonomous driving architecture that combines sparse computational efficiency with open-vocabulary generalization by using VLM-derived tokens as inputs to a physics-constrained optimization framework.

title: Leveraging systems' non-linearity to tackle the scarcity of data in the design of Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Systems
summary: Deep Transfer Learning (DTL) allows for the efficient building of Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Systems (IFDS). On the other hand, DTL methods still heavily rely on large amounts of labelled data. Obtaining such an amount of data can be challenging when dealing with machines or structures faults. This document proposes a novel approach to the design of vibration-based IFDS using DTL in condition of strong data scarcity. A periodic multi-excitation level procedure leveraging intrinsic non-linearities of real-world systems is used to produce images that can be conveniently analysed by pre-trained Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to diagnose faults. A new data visualization method and its augmentation technique are proposed in this paper to tackle the typical lack of data encountered during the design of IFDS. Experimental validation on a railway pantograph structure provides effective support for the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度迁移学习的振动智能故障诊断方法，通过周期多激励水平和系统固有非线性生成图像，利用预训练CNN在数据极度稀缺条件下实现有效故障诊断，并在铁路受电弓结构上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 深度迁移学习虽能高效构建智能故障诊断系统，但仍依赖大量标注数据。在实际机械/结构故障场景中获取充足标注数据极具挑战，亟需一种在数据极度稀缺条件下仍能有效工作的故障诊断方法。
AI.method: 提出周期性多激励水平流程，利用真实系统的固有非线性特性生成振动图像，使预训练的CNN能够方便地分析；同时提出一种新的数据可视化方法及其数据增强技术。
AI.result: 在铁路受电弓结构上的实验验证有效支持了所提出方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够在数据极度稀缺条件下，利用系统固有非线性和迁移学习，实现高效的振动智能故障诊断。
idea_en: A periodic multi-excitation level procedure leveraging intrinsic non-linearities of real-world systems to generate vibration images for pre-trained CNN-based fault diagnosis under strong data scarcity.
A novel data visualization method that converts vibration signals into images analyzable by pre-trained Convolutional Neural Networks, enabling transfer learning with minimal labeled data.
A data augmentation technique specifically designed for vibration-based fault diagnosis images to address the typical lack of training data in intelligent fault diagnosis systems.
A method integrating periodic multi-excitation with system intrinsic non-linearity to create discriminative fault features without requiring large labeled datasets.
idea_ch: 一种利用真实系统固有非线性的周期性多激励水平流程，生成振动图像，用于在数据极度稀缺条件下基于预训练CNN的故障诊断。
一种新颖的数据可视化方法，将振动信号转换为预训练卷积神经网络可分析的图像格式，实现少量标注数据下的迁移学习。
一种专用于振动故障诊断图像的数据增强技术，解决智能故障诊断系统中典型的数据缺乏问题。

title: SoftSkill: Behavioral Compression for Contextual Adaptation
summary: Agent skills are commonly deployed as natural-language Markdown files that encode answer policies, evidence-use habits, and task procedures. These files are readable and portable, but they are consumed indirectly: for each task instance, a frozen language model must translate a long textual artifact into generation-time behavior. This paper asks whether a natural-language skill can instead initialize a compact continuous context object, refined by a trainable soft delta while the base model remains frozen. We propose SoftSkill, a frozen-backbone method that tunes such soft skills with next-token prediction and deploys them as latent behavioral priors at inference time. In our main single-round setting, a length-32 SoftSkill prefix on Qwen3.5-4B improves over no-skill prompting by 8.3 points on SearchQA, 42.1 points on LiveMath, and 1.3 points on DocVQA. Relative to SkillOpt, SoftSkill improves accuracy by 5.2 points on SearchQA and 12.5 points on LiveMath, while replacing hundreds to thousands of Markdown skill tokens with a few virtual tokens. We further study agentic execution as a harder boundary case, where sparse trajectory imitation provides useful signal but does not yet robustly compress long-horizon procedural behavior. More broadly, the results suggest that some task skills are better treated not as additional Markdown to be reinterpreted at inference time, but as compact latent controls over how a frozen model enters the task.

AI.tldr: SoftSkill提出将自然语言技能（Markdown格式）转化为紧凑的连续上下文对象（soft skill），通过可训练的软增量（soft delta）微调，在冻结基座模型下实现高效的技能压缩与推理行为控制，在多个任务上优于传统提示方法。
AI.motivation: 传统基于Markdown的自然语言技能文件虽然可读性好、可迁移，但必须由冻结的语言模型在推理时将长篇文本重新解释为行为，间接且效率低。本文探索是否可以将自然语言技能直接初始化为紧凑的连续上下文对象，通过可训练的软增量进行精炼，同时保持基座模型冻结。
AI.method: SoftSkill方法：1) 将自然语言技能（Markdown）初始化为紧凑的连续上下文对象（soft skill）；2) 在冻结基座模型上，通过可训练的软增量（soft delta）进行精炼；3) 使用下一词预测（next-token prediction）进行训练；4) 推理时将软技能作为潜在行为先验（latent behavioral priors）注入。
AI.result: 在单轮设置中，长度32的SoftSkill前缀在Qwen3.5-4B上：SearchQA提升8.3点，LiveMath提升42.1点，DocVQA提升1.3点；相对SkillOpt方法，SearchQA提升5.2点，LiveMath提升12.5点，同时将数百至数千个Markdown技能token替换为少量虚拟token。
AI.conclusion: 部分任务技能更适合作为紧凑的潜在控制信号（而非推理时重新解释的Markdown文本），以控制冻结模型如何进入任务。稀疏轨迹模仿在智能体执行场景中提供有用信号，但尚不能稳健地压缩长程过程行为。
idea_en: A method for converting natural-language Markdown skill descriptions into compact continuous soft skill objects, initialized from the textual content and refined via a trainable soft delta while keeping the base language model frozen.

A soft skill injection mechanism that uses a length-limited prefix (e.g., 32 tokens) of continuous latent vectors as behavioral priors, replacing hundreds-to-thousands of discrete Markdown tokens for inference-time behavior control.

A training paradigm that tunes soft skills using next-token prediction loss on a frozen backbone model, enabling the soft skill to encode task-specific answer policies, evidence-use habits, and procedural knowledge.

A system architecture where natural-language procedural skills are compressed into latent continuous representations that serve as task-specific initialization for soft delta refinement, achieving both portability and inference efficiency.

A method for deploying compact latent controls (soft skills) at inference time to guide a frozen language model's behavior across different tasks, including single-round QA and multi-step agentic execution scenarios.
idea_ch: 一种将自然语言Markdown技能描述转化为紧凑连续软技能对象的方法，从文本内容初始化，通过可训练的软增量精炼，同时保持基座语言模型冻结。
一种软技能注入机制，使用长度受限（如32个token）的连续潜在向量前缀作为行为先验，替代数百至数千个离散Markdown token用于推理时行为控制。
一种训练范式，在冻结基座模型上使用下一词预测损失来微调软技能，使软技能能够编码任务特定的回答策略、证据使用习惯和程序性知识。
一种系统架构，将自然语言程序性技能压缩为潜在连续表示，作为软增量精炼的任务特定初始化，兼具可移植性和推理效率。
一种在推理时部署紧凑潜在控制（软技能）以引导冻结语言模型行为的方法，适用于单轮问答和多步智能体执行场景。

title: Automating SKILL.md Generation for Computer-Using Agents via Interaction Trajectory Mining
summary: Explicit skill libraries make computer-using agents easier to inspect, but it remains unclear whether such libraries can be mined from interaction data in a way that improves downstream policies. We study this question through a three-stage pipeline that segments GUI trajectories, clusters segments into candidate skills, and trains a skill-aware policy from the resulting annotations. The mined clusters are readable on the source benchmark: five of eight clusters have at least 0.95 purity against InteraSkill Workflows labels. However, readability does not imply transfer. GRPO improves IW skill-step accuracy only from 18.5\% to 20.5\%, leaves BrowseComp+ essentially unchanged, and underperforms trivial frequency priors on key source-domain metrics. We therefore present the method as a diagnostic study: trajectory mining can expose inspectable skill structure, but the current boundary detector, orderless segment representation, and offline reward model are insufficient for reliable cross-domain policy improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了从GUI交互数据中挖掘显式技能库的可行性，发现虽然能够挖掘出可读性高的技能聚类（5/8的聚类纯度≥0.95），但基于这些技能训练的智能体策略在下游任务中表现不佳，GRPO仅将IW技能步骤准确率从18.5%提升至20.5%，且无法改善BrowseComp+性能，甚至不如简单的频率先验。作者将此作为诊断性研究，指出当前边界检测器、无序段表示和离线奖励模型不足以支持可靠的跨领域策略改进。
AI.motivation: 探索是否能够从交互数据中自动挖掘可解释的技能库，并利用这些技能提升下游计算机使用智能体的策略性能。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：1) 分割GUI轨迹；2) 将分割后的片段聚类为候选技能；3) 基于聚类注释训练技能感知策略。使用GRPO进行策略优化。
AI.result: 挖掘的技能聚类在源基准上可读性高（5/8聚类纯度≥0.95），但GRPO仅将IW技能步准确率从18.5%提升至20.5%，BrowseComp+无变化，且在关键源域指标上不如简单频率先验。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹挖掘可以暴露可检查的技能结构，但当前的边界检测器、无序段表示和离线奖励模型不足以保证可靠的跨领域策略改进。
idea_en: A three-stage pipeline for mining explicit skill libraries from GUI interaction trajectories, comprising: (1) segmenting GUI trajectories into atomic segments, (2) clustering the segments into candidate skill clusters with high readability (purity ≥0.95), and (3) training a skill-aware policy using the resulting annotations.
A GRPO-based skill-aware policy optimization method that incorporates mined skill annotations into reinforcement learning for computer-using agents.

A diagnostic evaluation framework that systematically assesses the transferability of mined skill libraries from source benchmarks to downstream policy improvements, identifying specific bottlenecks (boundary detector, orderless segment representation, offline reward model).
A method for mining and evaluating readability of skill clusters against ground-truth skill workflow labels (InteraSkill Workflows) with purity metrics.
idea_ch: 一种从GUI交互轨迹中挖掘显式技能库的三阶段流水线方法：(1) 将GUI轨迹分割为原子片段；(2) 将片段聚类为高可读性（纯度≥0.95）的候选技能簇；(3) 利用聚类注释训练技能感知策略。
一种基于GRPO的技能感知策略优化方法，将挖掘到的技能注释融入计算机使用智能体的强化学习过程中。
一种诊断性评估框架，系统性地评估挖掘到的技能库从源基准到下游策略改进的可迁移性，并识别特定瓶颈（边界检测器、无序段表示、离线奖励模型）。
一种利用纯度指标评估技能聚类相对于真实技能工作流标签（InteraSkill Workflows）可读性的方法。

title: Rethinking Shrinkage Bias in LLM FP4 Pretraining: Geometric Origin, Systemic Impact, and UFP4 Recipe
summary: FP4 training promises substantial reductions in memory and computation cost for LLM pretraining, yet current FP4 hardware paths and recipes, including NVIDIA Blackwell/Rubin-class systems and AMD MI350-series GPUs, remain centered on E2M1 data elements. In this study, we identify a fundamental limitation of that choice: non-uniform formats such as E2M1 inherently suffer from Shrinkage Bias, a systematic negative rounding error caused by the geometric asymmetry of their representable bins. We show that this bias accumulates multiplicatively across layers and is amplified by the Random Hadamard Transform (RHT), providing a unified explanation for the training instability observed in existing E2M1-based FP4 recipes. In contrast, uniform grids (E1M2/INT4) bypass this grid-geometry error and better convert the improved bucket utilization from RHT into higher quantization quality. Based on this finding, we propose UFP4, a uniform 4-bit training recipe that applies RHT to all three training GEMMs while restricting stochastic rounding to dY alone. On Dense 1.5B, MoE 7.9B, and MoE 124B long-run pretraining, UFP4 consistently achieves lower BF16-relative loss degradation than strong E2M1-based baselines, supported by scaling-law analysis and ablation studies. Our results suggest that future accelerators should support E1M2/INT4-style uniform 4-bit grids as first-class training primitives alongside E2M1.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出现有FP4训练（如E2M1格式）存在“收缩偏差”（Shrinkage Bias），即非均匀格式因几何不对称导致的系统性负舍入误差，该误差会随层数累积并被随机哈达玛变换放大。为此提出UFP4，一种基于均匀网格（E1M2/INT4）的4-bit训练方案，在多个大规模模型上取得了更优的精度表现，并建议未来加速器应原生支持均匀4-bit格式。
AI.motivation: 现有FP4训练方案（基于E2M1非均匀格式）存在训练不稳定问题，但其根本原因尚未被清晰揭示。作者希望找出这一问题的根源并提出更优的4-bit训练方案。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析发现E2M1非均匀格式存在“收缩偏差”现象；2. 证明该偏差通过Random Hadamard Transform (RHT)被放大；3. 提出UFP4方案：采用均匀E1M2/INT4网格，对所有三个训练GEMM应用RHT，仅对dY使用随机舍入。
AI.result: 在Dense 1.5B、MoE 7.9B和MoE 124B长程预训练中，UFP4相比强E2M1基线持续获得更低的BF16相对损失退化，并通过缩放律分析和消融实验验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 未来加速器应原生支持E1M2/INT4风格的均匀4-bit网格，将其作为与E2M1并列的一等训练原语。
idea_en: A method for uniform 4-bit training (UFP4) that replaces non-uniform E2M1 format with uniform grid (E1M2/INT4) to eliminate Shrinkage Bias in FP4 training
Application of Random Hadamard Transform (RHT) to all three training GEMMs in 4-bit training to improve bucket utilization with uniform quantization
A selective stochastic rounding strategy restricted to dY only, combined with RHT on all GEMMs, for stable low-precision training
Identification and characterization of Shrinkage Bias as a systematic negative rounding error in non-uniform FP4 formats, providing a diagnostic framework for low-precision training instability
Hardware architecture design for future accelerators supporting E1M2/INT4 uniform 4-bit grids as first-class training primitives alongside E2M1
idea_ch: 一种均匀4-bit训练方法（UFP4），用均匀网格（E1M2/INT4）替代非均匀E2M1格式，消除FP4训练中的收缩偏差
将随机哈达玛变换（RHT）应用于4-bit训练中全部三个训练GEMM，通过均匀量化提高桶利用率的方案
一种选择性随机舍入策略，仅对dY应用随机舍入，同时对所有GEMM使用RHT，实现稳定的低精度训练
对非均匀FP4格式中收缩偏差作为系统性负舍入误差的识别与表征，为低精度训练不稳定性提供诊断框架
未来加速器中原生支持E1M2/INT4均匀4-bit网格与E2M1并列作为一等训练原语的硬件架构设计

title: Interpretable Sperm Morphology Classification via Attention-Guided Deep Learning
summary: Male infertility is a major cause of couple infertility, often linked to abnormal sperm morphology. While deep learning models offer automated analysis, most lack interpretability, limiting their clinical adoption. This study proposes an attention-guided deep learning framework for sperm morphology classification. We combine a pretrained EfficientNet-B0 with a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) to focus on key areas of the sperm head, improving both accuracy and interpretability. Evaluated on the SMIDS and HuSHem public datasets, our model achieves accuracies of 90.2% and 93.9% (macro F1 scores of 0.913 and 0.948), outperforming SimpleCNN and standard EfficientNet-B0. Furthermore, we use Grad-CAM++ visualizations to highlight features influencing the model's decisions. The results demonstrate that this accurate and transparent framework is a practical tool for automated sperm analysis in fertility clinics.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合EfficientNet-B0和CBAM注意力机制的深度学习框架用于精子形态分类，在SMIDS和HuSHem数据集上分别达到90.2%和93.9%的准确率，并通过Grad-CAM++可视化提高模型可解释性。
AI.motivation: 男性不育常与异常精子形态相关，现有深度学习模型缺乏可解释性，限制了其在临床中的应用。
AI.method: 采用预训练的EfficientNet-B0作为骨干网络，结合卷积块注意力模块(CBAM)聚焦精子头部关键区域，并使用Grad-CAM++进行决策可视化。
AI.result: 在SMIDS和HuSHem数据集上分别达到90.2%和93.9%的准确率，macro F1分数分别为0.913和0.948，优于SimpleCNN和标准EfficientNet-B0。
AI.conclusion: 该准确且透明的框架可作为生育诊所自动化精子分析的有效工具。
idea_en: Attention-guided CNN architecture combining pretrained EfficientNet-B0 with CBAM for sperm morphology classification
Grad-CAM++ based explainability mechanism for clinical interpretability in sperm analysis
Attention-enhanced feature extraction focused specifically on sperm head regions for morphological assessment
idea_ch: 基于预训练EfficientNet-B0与卷积块注意力模块(CBAM)结合的注意力引导精子形态分类网络架构
基于Grad-CAM++的精子分析临床可解释性可视化方法，提升医生对AI决策的信任度
针对精子头部区域进行注意力增强的特征提取技术，精准定位形态关键特征

title: Context-Aware Hierarchical Bayesian Modeling of IVF Laboratory Environmental Conditions
summary: IVF pregnancy rates are routinely modeled using patient-level variables, while high-resolution laboratory environmental data remain underutilized. We show that this is a missed opportunity. Rather than relying on raw sensor averages, we engineer 55 context-aware temporal features, including rolling thermal stability, simultaneous temperature-humidity adherence, peak stress duration, and post-stress recovery speed, that capture the dynamics of incubator microenvironments. On 61 weeks of data from an Asian IVF clinic, these features reduce cross-validated prediction error to 1.27%, compared to 3-5% for raw averages. We then train a hierarchical Bayesian Beta regression model that shares environmental effects across an Asian and a Northern European clinic via partial pooling, while preserving site-specific baselines. On held-out data from the Northern European clinic, the model achieves R2 = 0.86 and a 64% error reduction for the 35-39 age group over a naive baseline, demonstrating that structured environmental monitoring contains clinically meaningful, transferable signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用高分辨率实验室环境数据（而非传统患者变量）来预测IVF妊娠率的方法。通过工程化55个上下文感知的时序特征（如热稳定性、温湿度同步性、峰值应激时长等），结合分层贝叶斯Beta回归模型，在不同诊所间实现了环境信号的可迁移学习，显著降低了预测误差。
AI.motivation: 现有IVF妊娠率模型主要依赖患者级变量，而高分辨率的实验室环境数据（如培养箱微环境）未被充分利用，作者认为这是一个被忽视的机会。
AI.method: 1）从原始传感器数据中工程化55个上下文感知的时序特征；2）训练分层贝叶斯Beta回归模型，通过部分池化（partial pooling）在不同诊所间共享环境效应，同时保留站点特异基线。
AI.result: 在亚洲诊所数据上，交叉验证预测误差降至1.27%（原始均值方法为3-5%）；在北欧诊所的留出数据上，35-39岁年龄组R²=0.86，误差较基线降低64%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的环境监测包含临床上有意义且可迁移的信号，能够显著提升IVF妊娠率预测的准确性。
idea_en: A method for predicting IVF pregnancy outcomes using context-aware temporal features engineered from incubator microenvironment sensor data, including rolling thermal stability, simultaneous temperature-humidity adherence, peak stress duration, and post-stress recovery speed.

A hierarchical Bayesian Beta regression model with partial pooling that shares environmental effects across different IVF clinics while preserving site-specific baselines, enabling transfer learning of microenvironment signals.
A system for reducing IVF pregnancy prediction error by replacing raw sensor averages with 55 engineered temporal features that capture microenvironment dynamics.
idea_ch: 基于培养箱微环境传感器数据的上下文感知时序特征工程方法，包括滚动热稳定性、温湿度同步性、峰值应激时长和应激后恢复速度等55个特征，用于预测IVF妊娠结局。
一种分层贝叶斯Beta回归模型，通过部分池化技术在不同IVF诊所间共享环境效应同时保留站点特异基线，实现微环境信号的可迁移学习。
用工程化的时序特征替代原始传感器均值以降低IVF妊娠预测误差的系统，可将预测误差从3-5%降至1.27%。

title: What Do Safety-Aligned LLMs Learn From Mixed Compliance Demonstrations?
summary: Prior work has shown that in-context demonstrations can jailbreak language models, but it remains unclear how models interpret different types of compliance demonstrations. We study this by mixing benign compliance demonstrations (non-harmful request, helpful response) with harmful compliance demonstrations (harmful request, helpful response) and testing three hypotheses about how demonstration composition drives harmful compliance. Across four models, we find that benign and harmful demonstrations are not interchangeable: benign demonstrations can either reduce or increase harmful compliance depending on the model. We further show that preference optimization is the critical training stage that prevents benign demonstrations from increasing harmful compliance, that demonstration ordering exhibits strong recency bias, and that models differ in how refusal interacts with in-context learning: some adopt demonstrated formatting even when refusing, while others override all in-context signals upon refusal. Taken together, this work moves beyond showing that demonstration-based jailbreaking works to characterizing how it works: what models extract from compliance demonstrations depends on demonstration content, ordering, and training methodology.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了上下文演示（in-context demonstrations）如何通过不同组合方式（良性演示与有害演示）导致语言模型产生有害遵从行为，并发现演示内容、排序和训练方法共同影响模型行为。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明上下文演示可以越狱语言模型，但模型如何理解不同类型的遵从演示尚不清楚。作者旨在揭示演示组合驱动有害遵从的具体机制。
AI.method: 将良性遵从演示（无害请求+有帮助响应）与有害遵从演示（有害请求+有帮助响应）混合，测试三种关于演示组合如何驱动有害遵从的假设，在四个模型上进行实验。
AI.result: 良性和有害演示不可互换；良性演示可能减少或增加有害遵从（因模型而异）；偏好优化是阻止良性演示增加有害遵从的关键训练阶段；演示排序存在强近因偏差；模型在拒绝时如何处理上下文学习信号存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 本文超越了对演示越狱是否有效的表面研究，深入揭示了其工作机制：模型从遵从演示中提取的内容取决于演示内容、排序和训练方法。
idea_en: A method for controlling language model compliance behavior by strategically composing benign and harmful in-context demonstrations, where the ratio and order of demonstration types are optimized to either reduce or increase harmful compliance.

A training-stage-specific intervention technique that applies preference optimization after standard supervised fine-tuning to prevent benign compliance demonstrations from inadvertently increasing harmful compliance in language models.

A recency-aware demonstration ordering system for jailbreak attacks that exploits the observed bias where models are more influenced by compliance demonstrations appearing later in the context sequence.

A model-specific compliance characterization framework that classifies language models into types based on how their refusal mechanism interacts with in-context learning signals, distinguishing between models that adopt demonstration formatting during refusal versus those that override all in-context signals.
idea_ch: 一种通过策略性组合良性演示和有害演示来控制语言模型遵从行为的方法，通过优化两种演示的比例和顺序来减少或增加有害遵从。
一种分训练阶段的干预技术，在标准监督微调后应用偏好优化，防止良性遵从演示无意中增加语言模型的有害遵从行为。
一种利用近因偏差的演示排序系统，利用观察到的模型对上下文序列后出现的遵从演示更敏感的特性进行越狱攻击。
一种基于模型类型的遵从特征分类框架，根据拒绝机制与上下文学习信号的交互方式对语言模型进行分类，区分在拒绝时仍采用演示格式的模型与覆盖所有上下文信号的模型。

title: Multi-LCB: Extending LiveCodeBench to Multiple Programming Languages
summary:
LiveCodeBench (LCB) has recently become a widely adopted benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) on code-generation tasks. By curating competitive programming problems, constantly adding fresh problems to the set, and filtering them by release dates, LCB provides contamination-aware evaluation and offers a holistic view of coding capability. However, LCB remains restricted to Python, leaving open the question of whether LLMs can generalize across the diverse programming languages required in real-world software engineering.
  We introduce Multi-LCB, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs across twelve programming languages, including Python. Multi-LCB transforms Python tasks from the LCB dataset into equivalent tasks in other languages while preserving LCB's contamination controls and evaluation protocol. Because it is fully compatible with the original LCB format, Multi-LCB will automatically track future LCB updates, enabling systematic assessment of cross-language code generation competence and requiring models to sustain performance well beyond Python.
  We evaluated 24 LLMs for instruction and reasoning on Multi-LCB, uncovering evidence of Python overfitting, language-specific contamination, and substantial disparities in multilingual performance. Our results establish Multi-LCB as a rigorous new benchmark for multi-programming-language code evaluation, directly addressing LCB's primary limitation and exposing critical gaps in current LLM capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Multi-LCB基准，将LiveCodeBench从单语言（Python）扩展到12种编程语言，评估LLM的多语言代码生成能力，发现Python过拟合和语言特定污染问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LiveCodeBench基准仅限Python语言，无法评估LLM在真实软件工程中跨多种编程语言的泛化能力。
AI.method: 将LCB数据集的Python任务转换为12种编程语言的等价任务，保持原LCB的污染控制和评估协议，并兼容未来LCB更新。
AI.result: 评估24个LLM后，发现了Python过拟合、语言特定污染以及多语言性能显著差异的证据。
AI.conclusion: Multi-LCB成为严格的多语言代码评估新基准，弥补了LCB的主要局限，揭示了当前LLM能力的关键差距。
idea_en: Cross-language task transformation pipeline that converts Python code-generation problems into equivalent problems in multiple target languages while preserving problem semantics and evaluation protocols.
Contamination-controlled multilingual benchmark framework with automatic synchronization to upstream single-language benchmark updates.
Systematic multilingual code generation evaluation method that detects Python overfitting by comparing performance gaps across 12 programming languages.
Language-specific contamination detection technique for LLMs in code generation tasks across diverse programming languages.
idea_ch: 跨语言代码任务转换流水线：将Python代码生成问题自动转换为多种目标语言的等价问题，同时保留原问题语义和评估协议。
抗污染的多语言基准框架：能够自动同步上游单语言基准的更新，保持污染控制的持续有效性。
多语言代码生成能力系统评估方法：通过比较12种编程语言间的性能差距，检测LLM对Python的过拟合现象。
语言特定污染检测技术：识别LLM在多种编程语言代码生成任务中是否存在特定语言的训练数据污染。

title: FlowEdit: Associative Memory for Lifelong Pronunciation Adaptation in Flow-Matching TTS
summary: Flow-matching text-to-speech systems achieve remarkable zero-shot quality but remain static after deployment: pronunciation errors on out-of-vocabulary proper nouns persist unless the model is retrained. We introduce FlowEdit, a life-long adaptation framework for frozen flow-matching TTS that learns pronunciation corrections as latent conditioning edits rather than weight updates. When corrective feedback is provided, FlowEdit optimizes a token-level perturbation in the text embedding space, then stores the correction in a Modern Hopfield Network serving as content-addressable episodic memory. At inference, corrections are retrieved via soft attention with a similarity gate, enabling fuzzy morphological matching. On our curated benchmark of 312 multilingual proper nouns across 18 language families, FlowEdit reduces target-word Phoneme Error Rate by 92.7% relative to the zero-shot baseline while maintaining identical general-speech quality. Corrections complete in approximately 15 seconds on a single GPU.

AI.tldr: FlowEdit是一种面向冻结流匹配TTS系统的终身适配框架，通过文本嵌入空间的令牌级扰动学习和现代Hopfield网络存储纠正信息，无需重新训练模型即可修正OOV专有名词的发音错误，在312个多语种专有名词上实现92.7%的音素错误率降低。
AI.motivation: 流匹配文本转语音系统在部署后存在固有问题：对于词汇外（OOV）专有名词的发音错误无法修正，除非重新训练整个模型，这在实际应用中是高成本且低效的。
AI.method: 1) 当提供纠正反馈时，在文本嵌入空间中优化令牌级扰动（token-level perturbation）；2) 将纠正信息存储在Modern Hopfield Network中，作为内容可寻址的情节记忆；3) 推理时通过带相似性门控的软注意力检索纠正，实现模糊形态匹配。
AI.result: 在涵盖18个语系的312个多语种专有名词基准测试中，相对于零样本基线，目标词音素错误率相对降低92.7%，同时保持通用语音质量不变。每次纠正完成约需15秒（单GPU）。
AI.conclusion: FlowEdit证明了冻结流匹配TTS系统可以通过隐式潜变量条件编辑实现终身适应，而无需权重更新，为TTS系统的持续改进提供了高效实用的方案。
idea_en: Method for lifelong adaptation of frozen flow-matching TTS via latent conditioning edits in text embedding space using token-level perturbations
Content-addressable episodic memory system using Modern Hopfield Network for storing and retrieving pronunciation corrections in TTS
Similarity-gated soft attention retrieval mechanism with fuzzy morphological matching for OOV proper noun correction
Token-level perturbation optimization technique for correcting pronunciation errors without model retraining
Episodic memory-based TTS correction framework that maintains general speech quality while fixing specific pronunciation errors
idea_ch: 基于文本嵌入空间令牌级扰动的冻结流匹配TTS终身适应方法，无需重新训练模型即可纠正发音
利用现代Hopfield网络构建内容可寻址情节记忆系统，用于存储和检索TTS发音纠正信息
带相似性门控的软注意力检索机制，实现模糊形态匹配的OOV专有名词纠正
令牌级扰动优化技术，在保持模型冻结状态下修正特定词汇发音错误
基于情节记忆的TTS纠正框架，在不影响通用语音质量前提下精准修复发音错误

title: DeepSWIP: Quotient-WMC Counterfactuals for Neural Probabilistic Logic Programs
summary: Neurosymbolic systems such as DeepProbLog combine neural perception with probabilistic logic, but standard inference is associational. Counterfactual reasoning additionally requires a causal semantics for interventions and evidence. We introduce DeepSWIP, a single-world counterfactual semantics for DeepProbLog programs. Using neural materialization, we reduce fixed-context neural predicates to ordinary ProbLog choices, apply Single World Intervention Programs (SWIPs), and compute counterfactuals by weighted model counting (WMC) over a single transformed program. Under finite grounding and unique-supported-model assumptions, DeepSWIP is exact relative to the learned materialized FCM. The standard quotient-WMC form of ProbLog conditionals identifies active neural probabilities and explains intervention cleaning, calibration sensitivity, and rare-evidence instability. Experiments on MPI3D confirm the transformation against a DeepTwin construction against 12,000 queries, as predicted and a 2.14$\times$ inference speedup from avoiding the Twin's endogenous duplication. A SUMO HOV experiment shows that neural calibration degradation biases plug-in estimates, while a correctly scoped randomized-policy AIPW estimator removes most first-order bias for population mean and ATE estimands. Code is at https://github.com/saibib/deep_SWIP.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepSWIP，一种用于DeepProbLog程序的单世界反事实语义。通过神经物化将神经谓词简化为普通ProbLog选择，应用单世界干预程序(SWIP)计算反事实，在MPI3D和SUMO HOV实验上验证了准确性和2.14倍加速。
AI.motivation: 神经符号系统(如DeepProbLog)的标准推理是关联性的，缺乏因果语义来支持干预和证据的反事实推理。
AI.method: 1) 通过神经物化将固定上下文的神经谓词简化为普通ProbLog选择；2) 应用单世界干预程序(SWIP)；3) 通过对单个转换程序进行加权模型计数(WMC)计算反事实。
AI.result: 在MPI3D上，针对12,000个查询验证了转换的正确性，相比DeepTwin方法实现2.14倍推理加速。SUMO HOV实验表明神经校准退化会偏倚插补估计，而正确范围的随机化策略AIPW估计器可消除大部分一阶偏差。
AI.conclusion: DeepSWIP在有限基化和唯一支持模型假设下，相对于学习的物化FCM是精确的。商WMC形式识别活性神经概率并解释干预清洗、校准敏感性和罕见证据不稳定性。
idea_en: Single-world counterfactual semantics for neurosymbolic systems (DeepSWIP) that avoids endogenous duplication of twin networks, achieving 2.14x inference speedup
Neural materialization technique that reduces fixed-context neural predicates to ordinary ProbLog choices for causal reasoning
Quotient-WMC (Weighted Model Counting) form of ProbLog conditionals that identifies active neural probabilities and explains intervention cleaning behavior
Calibration-sensitive AIPW estimator for neurosymbolic causal inference that removes first-order bias from neural calibration degradation
Single-world intervention program (SWIP) transformation for computing counterfactuals via WMC over a single transformed program
idea_ch: 面向神经符号系统的单世界反事实语义(DeepSWIP)，避免孪生网络的内生重复，实现2.14倍推理加速
神经物化技术：将固定上下文的神经谓词简化为普通ProbLog选择，支持因果推理
ProbLog条件概率的商WMC(加权模型计数)形式，可识别活性神经概率并解释干预清洗行为
面向神经符号因果推理的校准敏感AIPW估计器，消除神经校准退化引起的一阶偏差
单世界干预程序(SWIP)转换方法：通过单个转换程序的WMC计算反事实

title: LedgerAgent: Structured State for Policy-Adherent Tool-Calling Agents
summary: Policy-adherent tool-calling agents in customer-service domains must maintain task states across turns while calling tools and obeying domain policies. Task states consist of relevant facts, identifiers, constraints, and conditions observed through user interaction and tool calls. In standard agents, task states are not represented separately. Observations, tool returns, and policy instructions are placed in the prompt, leaving agents to reconstruct the relevant states from the prompt each time they decide what to do next. This design makes state management implicit, creating two common failure modes. An agent may retrieve the right facts but later ground its decision in stale, missing, or incorrect information; and a syntactically valid tool call may still violate a domain policy that depends on the current task state. We introduce \textsc{LedgerAgent}, an inference-time method for tool-calling agents that maintains observed task states in a separate ledger and renders the states into the prompt. The ledger is also used to check state-dependent policy constraints before environment-changing tool calls are executed, blocking policy violations. Across four customer-service domains and a mixed panel of open- and closed-weight models, \textsc{LedgerAgent} improves average pass\textasciicircum{}k over a standard prompt-based tool-calling approach, with the largest gains under stricter multi-trial consistency metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出LedgerAgent方法，通过独立账本维护任务状态并检查策略约束，提升客服领域工具调用智能体的状态管理与策略合规性。
AI.motivation: 标准工具调用智能体不显式表示任务状态，导致状态管理隐式化，易出现使用过时/错误信息决策以及违反域策略的失败模式。
AI.method: LedgerAgent将观测到的任务状态维护在独立账本中，将状态渲染到prompt，并在环境变更工具调用前用账本检查状态相关策略约束，阻止违规。
AI.result: 在四个客服领域和多种开源/闭源模型上，LedgerAgent相比标准prompt方法提升了平均pass^k，在更严格的多轮一致性指标下增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 显式状态管理可有效提升工具调用智能体的策略合规性和状态准确性，尤其在多轮对话场景下优势显著。
idea_en: A method for tool-calling agents that maintains observed task states in a separate ledger structure, distinct from the prompt, to ensure state persistence across multi-turn interactions.
A state-dependent policy constraint checking mechanism that intercepts environment-changing tool calls and blocks violations before execution, based on current task state in the ledger.
An inference-time rendering technique that converts the structured ledger of task states into natural language prompts for the language model, enabling explicit state grounding.
A system for detecting and preventing stale, missing, or incorrect information usage by comparing agent's current reasoning against the independently maintained state ledger.
A multi-turn task state tracking approach for customer-service domains that separates factual facts, identifiers, constraints, and conditions into structured storage.
idea_ch: 一种独立于prompt的账本结构，用于维护工具调用智能体在多轮交互中的观测任务状态，确保状态持久化。
基于当前任务状态的状态相关策略约束检查机制，在环境变更工具调用执行前拦截并阻止策略违规。
将结构化任务状态账本转换为自然语言prompt的推理时渲染技术，使语言模型能够显式基于状态进行决策。
通过对比智能体当前推理与独立维护的状态账本，检测并防止使用过时、缺失或错误信息的系统。
针对客服领域的多轮任务状态追踪方法，将事实、标识符、约束和条件分离存储到结构化存储中。

title: How Do Instructions Shape Speech? Cross-Attention Attribution for Style-Captioned Text-to-Speech
summary: Style-captioned text-to-speech systems use natural language to control voice characteristics, but how individual words influence acoustic output remains unclear. Understanding this is critical for diagnosing failure modes and improving controllability in expressive TTS. We propose cross-attention attribution for speech diffusion models, adapting the DAAM framework to the speech domain for the first time, and apply it to CapSpeech-TTS. Our method extracts per-token heatmaps across 25 layers and 24 ODE steps. We analyze 3,600 (style caption, text transcript) combinations comprising 120 style captions conditioning the generation of 30 text transcripts each, revealing how caption tokens shape waveforms. Results show: (1) style tokens have lower temporal variance than content/function tokens, confirming global conditioning; (2) style attention correlates with F0 and energy; (3) style conditioning peaks in early steps and deep layers; (4) attention entropy reaches its minimum at layer 17, co-occurring with the style importance peak, indicating maximal network selectivity at the most style-critical stage. This is the first study of how natural language influences cross-attention in speech diffusion models

AI.tldr: 本文首次将DAAM框架适配到语音扩散模型领域，提出跨注意力归因方法，系统分析CapSpeech-TTS中风格描述词如何通过交叉注意力影响语音波形生成，揭示了风格标记在时间、层数和ODE步骤中的全局调节特性及其与声学特征的相关性。
AI.motivation: 风格字幕文本到语音系统使用自然语言控制语音特征，但单个词语如何影响声学输出尚不明确，理解这一机制对于诊断故障模式和改善 expressive TTS 的可控性至关重要。
AI.method: 提出面向语音扩散模型的交叉注意力归因方法，首次将DAAM框架适配到语音领域，应用于CapSpeech-TTS。提取跨25层和24个ODE步骤的每标记热力图，分析了3,600种(风格描述, 文本转录)组合。
AI.result: (1)风格标记的时间方差低于内容/功能标记，确认全局调节特性；(2)风格注意力与F0和能量相关；(3)风格调节在早期步骤和深层达到峰值；(4)注意力熵在第17层达到最小值，与风格重要性峰值同时发生，表明网络在最关键的风格阶段具有最大选择性。
AI.conclusion: 这是首次研究自然语言如何影响语音扩散模型中的交叉注意力，为理解风格控制机制和提升TTS系统可解释性提供了新方法。
idea_en: A cross-attention attribution method adapted from DAAM framework specifically for speech diffusion models, enabling per-token heatmap visualization of how style caption tokens influence waveform generation across multiple layers and ODE steps.

A systematic analysis framework for evaluating the temporal variance of style tokens versus content/function tokens in style-captioned TTS, confirming the global conditioning nature of style descriptors.
A correlation analysis methodology linking cross-attention weights of style tokens to acoustic features (F0 and energy) in speech diffusion models.

An attention entropy analysis technique revealing that minimal entropy at specific network layers (layer 17) coincides with maximal style importance, indicating a critical stage of network selectivity for style conditioning.
idea_ch: 一种基于DAAM框架适配语音扩散模型的交叉注意力归因方法，能够生成每标记热力图，可视化风格描述词在多层和多ODE步骤中如何影响语音波形生成。
一种针对风格字幕TTS系统的系统性分析方法，评估风格标记与内容/功能标记的时间方差差异，确认风格描述词的全局调节特性。
一种将风格标记的交叉注意力权重与声学特征（F0和能量）相关联的分析方法，用于语音扩散模型的声学可解释性。
一种注意力熵分析方法，用于检测风格条件化过程中网络选择性最大的关键层（第17层），该层注意力熵最小且风格重要性达到峰值。

title: Toward Calibrated Mixture-of-Experts Under Distribution Shift
summary: Calibration aligns a model's predictive uncertainty with the frequencies of its empirical outcomes and is important for understanding and trusting reported probabilities. Recent work shows that enforcing calibration at the level of individual predictors can improve ensemble accuracy and calibration, with mixture-of-experts (MoE) models showing strong empirical improvements in particular; however, the conditions under which calibration helps MoE are not well understood. In this work, we study how MoE models behave under distribution shift, focusing on how routing mechanisms interact with expert-level calibration. We show that expert calibration is sufficient to ensure calibration of the overall model under a broad class of distribution shifts in hard-routed models, but is insufficient for calibrating soft-routed models. To address this, we propose an adversarial reweighting that penalizes calibration errors of the routed aggregate under distribution shift, and we demonstrate that it improves the accuracy-calibration tradeoff both on average and on difficult subsets of the data, across model classes, prediction tasks, and distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合专家模型（MoE）在分布偏移下的校准行为，发现硬路由模型中专家级校准足以保证整体模型校准，但软路由模型不足。提出对抗性重加权方法以改善分布偏移下的精度-校准权衡。
AI.motivation: 理解校准在混合专家模型中起作用的条件，特别是在分布偏移下路由机制与专家级校准的交互作用。
AI.method: 理论分析了硬路由和软路由MoE模型在分布偏移下的校准性质，提出对抗性重加权方法惩罚分布偏移下路由聚合的校准误差。
AI.result: 硬路由模型中专家校准足以保证整体模型校准；软路由模型不足。对抗性重加权方法改善了精度-校准权衡。
AI.conclusion: 专家级校准在硬路由下对分布偏移具有鲁棒性，软路由下需额外处理；对抗性重加权可有效改善校准-精度权衡。
idea_en: A method for calibrating mixture-of-experts models under distribution shift by adversarial reweighting that penalizes calibration errors of routed aggregate predictions.
A technique for ensuring overall model calibration in hard-routed mixture-of-experts through expert-level calibration alone, applicable under a broad class of distribution shifts.
A soft-routing calibration mechanism for mixture-of-experts that addresses the insufficiency of expert-level calibration under distribution shift via adversarial optimization.
idea_ch: 一种通过对抗性重加权来校准分布偏移下混合专家模型的方法，通过惩罚路由聚合预测的校准误差。
一种在硬路由混合专家模型中仅通过专家级校准即可保证整体模型校准的技术，适用于广泛的分布偏移场景。
一种针对软路由混合专家模型的校准机制，通过对抗性优化解决分布偏移下专家级校准不足的问题。
